_comment: Optional second XR-1 recoverability-ladder run (schema 2): five more composite tasks with the pilot protocol. Analyze together with the pilot by passing both runs' shard dirs to analyze. See docs/recoverability_ladder.md.
_task_selection: DeliverStraw, KettleBoiling, MakeIceLemonade and WashFruitColander are the planned expansion of docs/safe_xiaomi_dense_subtask.md; GetToastedBread (the fifth) is replaced by SetUpCuttingStation because the toaster's on/timer state (Toaster._turned_on, _num_steps_on) and env.toaster_on live outside MuJoCo, so approximate state restores cannot reset them. All five have curated ordered predicates in eval_composite_predicates.py and success depends on MuJoCo state only.
_expected_success_rates_source: Fresh XR-1 natural rollouts, 50 per task (docs/safe_robocasa_experiment_report.md section 13.4, the 39-task collection of docs/safe_xiaomi_robotics_1.md): DeliverStraw 18/50, KettleBoiling 29/50, MakeIceLemonade 19/50, WashFruitColander 31/50, SetUpCuttingStation 32/50.
_predicate_risk: No ladder evidence yet. DeliverStraw drawer_open and MakeIceLemonade fridge_open are is_open(0.90) preconditions on fixtures that start closed (the ArrangeBreadBasket cabinet_open pattern); SetUpCuttingStation drawer_open is opened at reset and should audit as true_at_reset. Run naturals + audit-predicates and add exclude_predicates before branching.
